_doc: Trigger eval for the skill description: should the skill load before the first web search or fetch? `split` keeps a held-out test set so a description isn't tuned to the queries it is scored on. Run: python3 tests/evals.py triggers

queries.query: Find me a source confirming that Einstein said "If you can't explain it simply, you don't understand it well enough." It's going on the first slide of my onboarding deck.
I'm putting together a reading for my journalism seminar: find how Fox News and The Guardian each covered the 2024 Boeing door-plug blowout in their first-day stories and compare the framing.
is it true that we only use 10% of our brains? my nephew keeps saying it, look it up
What's the current LTS version of Node.js and when does it go end-of-life? Check online, I need it for our upgrade ticket.
A LinkedIn post claims remote workers are 13% more productive than office workers. Track down the original study it's based on.
can you look up what the EU AI Act actually says about emotion recognition in the workplace? need the article number
Verify this attribution for me before I tweet it: Ruth Bader Ginsburg supposedly said "Real change, enduring change, happens one step at a time." Where and when did she say it?
For a media studies assignment, pull up how Jacobin and the Wall Street Journal editorial page wrote about the 2023 UAW strike and contrast their language.
How much did US egg prices rise in 2025? search and give me the official number
Our pentest report flags CVE-2023-44487. Look up whether nginx 1.24 is affected and what the fix is.

Format these three references in APA 7th edition: Smith 2019 Nature paper on coral bleaching, a 2021 WHO report on air quality, and a NYT article from March 2022. I'll paste the details below. Don't look anything up, just format.
Write a Python scraper with requests and BeautifulSoup that pulls headlines from a news homepage URL passed on the command line. Just the code, I'll run it myself.
Draft a 300-word op-ed arguing that cities should ban cars from downtown on weekends. Persuasive tone, no need for citations.
In my Claude Code settings.json, how do I allow WebFetch only for docs.python.org? Just edit .claude/settings.json in this repo.
Rewrite this paragraph so it sounds less academic: 'The extant literature substantively demonstrates a heterogeneous array of outcomes vis-a-vis remote work productivity.'
Explain from what you already know, in plain words, what a DOI is and why journal articles have them. No need to search.
Write unit tests for a function rank_sources(urls) that sorts URLs so .gov and .edu come first. Pytest, no network calls.
Help me outline a blog post about how to spot misinformation online: five sections with a one-line summary each. Outline only.
What's 17.5% of 2,340? And round it to the nearest ten.
Turn my notes into a bulleted meeting summary: we agreed to ship v2 on Friday, Sara owns QA, the pricing page still needs legal review.
